verdict.rationale: Intel's own marketing makes generic claims of low-power engines, intelligent power management and longer battery life when unplugged. However, these claims are page-level and not specific to the 258V, and the pack offers no battery-life figures, design-win details or independent tests. missing for 10: evidence of shipping fanless/thin-and-quiet designs, quantified battery-life results, independent or hands-on battery corroboration, 258V-specific power/TDP documentation

support.subject: As a power-user, this chip powers thin, quiet, all-day-battery machines — shipping in fanless or low-power designs with credible battery-life evidence

citations.quote: Dedicated low-power AI engines and intelligent power management drive smart performance, even when you leave the charger behind.
Smart power efficiency, so your battery lasts longer and performs unplugged.
